sources.summary: This alterations and additions project to a Californian bungalow welcomes an abundance of natural light and celebrates the passage of time throughout the day. Briefed with renovating and extending a Californian bungalow, we opted to move away from formal expectations and create a project attuned to the present and to the needs of a young family.
